input.rationale: Section 9 is limited to mutual corporate representations (organization, authority, enforceability, no conflicts) plus an HDI acknowledgement about the Globix Agreement. Nothing in Sections 1, 5 or 9 obliges HDI to perform the design, development, hosting and maintenance Services in a professional and workmanlike manner, warrants that the Site will conform to the specifications the Company approves under Section 5.2, or provides any repair/re-performance/refund remedy; there is also no compliance-with-laws or malicious-code warranty. The only performance-related protection is the Section 1.6 launch deadline with a termination right. There is no disclaimer of implied warranties (so this is not walk-away territory), but the absence of any express performance warranty fails even the fallback (90 days software / 30 days services with remedies). Per the detection guidance, a missing express warranty is a deviation, so we insert the preferred warranty and remedy as a new Section 9(c), flagging the 90-day fallback in the comment.

proposal.summary: Add an HDI performance warranty (workmanlike services, Site conformance for 12 months, legal compliance, no malicious code) with a repair/re-perform/refund remedy in Section 9.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 contains only mutual corporate authority representations, so HDI gives no warranty that the Site or its development, hosting and maintenance services will actually work. We have added our standard performance warranty — workmanlike services, Site conformance to the specifications the Company approves under Section 5.2, legal compliance and no malicious code — with a re-performance, repair/replacement or refund remedy. If helpful, we can accept a ninety (90) day conformance period for the Site as a fallback.

ops.text: (c) HDI warrants that (1) the Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards; (2) for a period of twelve (12) months following the Effective Date, the Site will conform in all material respects to the specifications and documentation accepted and approved by the Company pursuant to Section 5.2; (3) it will perform the Services in compliance with all applicable laws, rules and regulations; and (4) the Site, and any software or files provided or made accessible to the Company hereunder, will be free of viruses, worms and other malicious or disabling code. The Company's remedy for breach of this warranty is, at HDI's option, re-performance, repair or replacement, or a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming Services or affected portion of the Site.
